definition: Where a node sits in the taxonomy: a tradition, the broadest trunk; a family sharing one generative logic; a style a client would select; or a variant, the regional or period expression at which a kit can actually be built.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json, the rank field: "tradition = civilizational trunk; family = coherent grouping sharing a generative logic; style = the nameable style a client would select". docs/model.md: "The regional or period expression at which a kit is actually buildable".
